title: muscarimia macrocarpa

This plant has been utilized for its various health benefits, including its potential to aid in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. Additionally, it has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, although its use should be approached with caution due to its potential toxicity and psychoactive effects.
